metaDescription: Source heavy duty tape measures from a China manufacturer. Compare steel blade options, rubberized cases, custom logo, retail packaging and QC support for B2B orders.
introduction: WOOKTOOL heavy duty tape measures are built for construction, hardware and industrial supply programs that need a practical case, readable steel blade and dependable locking and retraction performance. Buyers can compare length, blade unit and packaging requirements before confirming a sample or bulk order.

For private-label programs, wooktools can review logo placement, shell color, metric or imperial blade layout, hook style, belt clip, wrist strap, barcode and carton mark. The right configuration depends on the target channel, required shelf presentation and planned order quantity.

A complete RFQ should state the desired length and blade width, target market, quantity, logo file, packaging format and required delivery date. These details help the factory confirm a suitable existing model, sample direction and inspection plan.

faq.question: Which lengths can be quoted for a heavy duty tape measure?
faq.answer: Common directions include 3m, 5m, 7.5m and 10m, with metric, imperial or dual-scale blade layouts reviewed against the selected model and target market.

faq.question: Can the heavy duty tape measure carry a private-label logo?
faq.answer: Yes. Logo label or printing, shell color, barcode, packaging artwork and carton marks can be discussed for private-label programs.

faq.question: What should construction-tool buyers confirm before ordering?
faq.answer: Confirm length, blade width, scale unit, hook style, case material, lock function, packaging, quantity and any required quality checks before sample approval.

faq.question: How is heavy duty tape measure quality checked?
faq.answer: Typical checks cover blade printing and readability, lock and retraction performance, hook rivets, case assembly, belt clip, lanyard and finished packaging.

faq.question: Can wooktools provide retail packaging?
faq.answer: Yes. Options such as color boxes, blister cards, display boxes, barcodes and export-carton marks can be reviewed for the chosen model.
